column2: Retain David's identification of this as the Lord God's house and this altar as Israel's burnt-offering altar. The demonstratives connect to the preceding site; no completed temple building is asserted.
Retain all resident foreigners gathered and quarrymen appointed to dress stones for God's house. Resident foreigners does not assume the later technical sense of religious converts.
Retain iron for doorway and gate nails and hinges, and bronze beyond weighing. The selected hardware categories remain distinct, without a fabricated quantity.
Retain uncounted cedar and its abundant supply by both Sidonians and Tyrians. No purchase terms or individual king are imported.

Retain Solomon as a tender child, the house's intended greatness and renown throughout the earth, and David's abundant preparations before death. Must rise to greatness is the inherited reading of the elliptical scale expression.
column3: The antecedent of for it could be the house or Solomon in Greek; the inherited neuter English choice remains provisional.

column2: Retain David calling his son Solomon and commanding the construction of the Lord God's house. Solomon is the object of calling, not a new subject who calls his own son.
Retain Child as direct address and David's intention upon his soul to build for God's name. The repeated name-and-house relation is not flattened into a generic building project.
Retain abundant bloodshed, great wars, the prohibition and the repeated bloodshed before God. No additional moral or military rationale is supplied beyond the reported divine explanation.

Retain present is born, a man of rest, rest from all surrounding enemies, the name Solomon and peace and quietness in his days. Do not change the temporal form merely because Solomon is already addressed in the surrounding narrative.
Retain the son's house-building, the son/Father relation and his kingdom's throne established in Israel for ever. This is the conclusion of the quoted divine speech, not David calling himself Father.
Retain the Lord with Solomon, His granting success and Solomon building as spoken concerning him. The Greek future euodosei is third person, so the English does not silently make it you will prosper.

Retain the restrictive introductory only, the wish for wisdom and understanding, strengthening over Israel and observing and doing the law. Here only has a selected restrictive construction behind it, unlike an unsupported exclusivity addition.

Retain then He will grant success with the condition of observing the ordinances and judgments commanded to Moses. Courage and strength are followed by both fear prohibitions; ordinary you addresses Solomon.

Retain according to my poverty alongside one hundred thousand gold talents and one million silver talents. Bronze and iron remain unweighed, timber and stone prepared, and Solomon commanded to add to them.
column3: The poverty expression remains lexically difficult in relation to the quantities; no hardship gloss or corrected total is silently adopted.

column2: Retain abundant workers and the distinct artisans, stone builders, wood carpenters and everyone skilled in every work. No specific craft group is reduced to one supervisor.

Retain the repeated four material names, no counting, the commands to rise and act, and the Lord-with-you conclusion. The ellipse after the materials remains open rather than assigning an invented total.
column3: Whether no counting concerns materials, workers skilled in them or both requires syntactic review.

column2: Retain all Israel's rulers commanded to support Solomon, David's son. The next speech therefore addresses a plural audience rather than Solomon alone.
Retain the rhetorical question, rest on every side, inhabitants delivered into hands and the land subjected before the Lord and His people. No unexpressed your or their is inserted into hands.
column3: Into hands is an awkward retained ellipse; the intended possessor and an idiomatic English treatment remain open.

column2: Retain plural hearts and souls, seeking God, rising to build the sanctuary and bringing both covenant ark and holy vessels into the house for the Lord's name. The temple contents are purposes, not claims that construction is complete.
Retain David old and full of days and his making Solomon king in his place over Israel. The transitive construction identifies David as installing Solomon, despite the adjacent indeclinable name.
Retain the gathering of all Israel's rulers, priests and Levites. The three categories are preserved without an added location.
Retain the initial thirty-year threshold, counting men head by head and thirty-eight thousand. Do not regularize this age to the later twenty-year threshold.
Retain twenty-four thousand overseeing the house's works and six thousand scribes and judges. The latter count applies to the joined offices, not six thousand for each.
Retain four thousand gatekeepers and four thousand praising with the instruments he made. The maker is unnamed in this clause; David is a contextual inference, not an explicit repeated name.
Retain David's division into service courses and the three names Gedson, Kaath and Merari. Courses is an administrative rendering, not a newly specified weekly duration.
Retain Parosom, Edan and Semei in the selected continued dative list. Do not silently emend Parosom to Gersom or insert a missing sons-of relation.
column3: The identity and syntactic relation of Parosom remain unresolved; this is not an accepted harmonized genealogy.

column2: Retain Edan's Jiiel as ruler, Zethom and Joel, and the stated three. The rank is attached to Jiiel, not shared among all three names.
Retain Semei's three named sons and the closing ancestral rulers of Edan. The apparent shift of family name is selected and is not corrected to Semei.
Retain the further Semei list of Jeth, Ziza, Joas and Beria, with the explicit four. Do not merge this roster with the preceding three names.
Retain Jeth first, Ziza second and the combined house of Joas and Beria because their sons were few. One inspection expresses the single administrative registration, not one visit.
Retain Kaath's Ambram, Issaar, Chebron and Oziel and the total four. Name forms are not normalized against earlier family lists.

Retain Aaron and Moses, Aaron's separation with his sons as most holy, incense, ministry and invocation of God's name for ever. The selected passive consecration is not replaced with Aaron consecrating objects.
column3: Review the precise sense of epeuchesthai and most holy: invocation is provisional and is not automatically blessing the people in God's name.

column2: Retain Moses designated man of God and his sons called into Levi's tribe. The wording does not assign Moses' sons Aaron's distinct priestly role.
Retain Gersam and Eliezer as Moses' sons. Gersam remains distinct in spelling from the earlier Gedson list.
Retain plural sons as the heading with the single named Soubael the ruler. Do not add unnamed siblings or convert the heading into an asserted multiple-son count.

Retain plural sons followed by Raabia, explicit absence of other sons for Eliezer and Raabia's greatly increasing descendants. The later increase belongs to Raabia's sons, not Eliezer's immediate offspring.
Retain Salomoth as Issaar's named ruler. The form differs from Salomith in verse 9 and is not silently unified.
Retain Idoud, Amadia, Oziel and Ikemias with their explicit first-through-fourth order. No rank is inferred from a different parallel genealogy.
Retain Michas as ruler and Isia second among Oziel's sons. This Oziel is the family head, not necessarily the identically named third son in the preceding roster.
Retain Merari's Mooli and Mousi, then Mooli's Eleazar and Kis. The second generation is not merged with the first.

Retain Eleazar dying without sons but with daughters, and Kis's sons taking them as wives. Kinsmen is the contextual family sense of brothers; the preceding genealogy identifies collateral relatives rather than the daughters' own brothers.
Retain Mousi's Mooli, Eder and Jarimoth and the explicit three. Repeated Mooli in different generations is not removed.

Retain houses, rulers, inspection, names and head-by-head enumeration, followed by ministry from twenty upward. The repeated administrative descriptions and changed age are not collapsed into the chapter's earlier thirty-year count.

Retain the Lord giving His people rest and dwelling in Jerusalem for ever. The inherited English takes the Lord as subject of dwelling; no unexpressed causative settlement of the people is substituted.
Retain the Levites not carrying the tent and all its service vessels. No longer is a contextual rendering of the changed situation, not a separately expressed anymore adverb.

Retain the twenty-year threshold in David's last words. Record supplies an English predicate for the Greek there-is-the-number construction; it does not claim a separately identified archival document.
Retain appointment at Aaron's hand, courts, chambers, purification of all holy things and service works. Do not insert sons of Aaron into the selected singular Aaron phrase.

Retain presentation bread, sacrifice flour, unleavened cakes, pan preparation, mixed preparation and every measure. Preparation supplies the elliptical food nouns; no separate size-measure term or recipe is added.
column3: The exact forms of pan and mixed preparations remain lexical questions, not settled culinary identifications.

column2: Retain standing in the morning for praise and thanksgiving and the same in the evening. The two times and two praise actions remain distinct.
Retain all offered whole burnt offerings, sabbaths, new moons and feasts, and the prescribed number and ordinance continually before the Lord. No invented schedule or numerical quota is supplied.
Retain future keeping of the Tent of Testimony's charges and the charges of their Aaronite brethren for ministry. Do not import an additional sanctuary-charge phrase absent from the selected text.
